whatWeDo.title: What We Do
whatWeDo.desc: We provide a specialized treasury system with a focus on Letters of Guarantee (LG) custody, ensuring nothing slips through the cracks. From auto-renewals to tracking communications, our platform is built to make treasurers’ lives easier and businesses more secure.

expiry.title: Expired or missed LG renewals.
expiry.desc: Manual tracking often leads to last-minute scrambles and potential financial risk.

communication.title: Inconsistent communication.
communication.desc: Tracking communication with banks and internally is a daily challenge.

transparency.title: Lack of transparency.
transparency.desc: LG documents and statuses are spread across emails and spreadsheets.

manual.title: Manual follow-ups.
manual.desc: Producing reports for audits is a time-consuming and manual process.

howItWorks.title: How It Works: A Step-by-Step Walkthrough
howItWorks.desc: Our system transforms the LG management process from a chaotic scramble into a clear, controlled workflow. Here's a look at how it works in practice.

step1.title: 1. Recording a New LG
step1.desc: Bringing an LG into the system is fast and simple. Capture all LG details in less than a minute using our AI powered recording tool.
step1.point1: **Upload & Extract:** Just upload a scanned copy of the LG. Our AI-powered tool instantly auto-extracts key fields like expiry date, amount, and bank.
step1.point2: **Add Context:** Add your internal data, such as the internal owner, category, or project name.
step1.point3: **Upload & Extract:** Just upload a scanned copy of the LG. Our AI-powered tool instantly auto-extracts key fields like expiry date, amount, and bank.

step2.title: 2. Smart Reminders & Tracking
step2.desc: Manual tracking is a thing of the past. The system continuously monitors every LG and keeps you ahead of every deadline.

alerts.title: Proactive Alerts
alerts.desc: Automatic reminders for expiries and renewals to all relevant parties.

renewals.title: Automate Renewals
renewals.desc: The system suggests renewals and generates extension letters with one click.

templates.title: Template Library
templates.desc: Use built-in templates or your own for all LG communications.

step3.title: 3. The LG Life Cycle & Action Center
step3.desc: No more hunting for documents or status updates. The platform gives you a single, unified view of your entire LG portfolio.

lifecycle.title: Life Cycle View
lifecycle.desc: Every LG has a comprehensive, "always-on" life cycle view. You can see the current status, every action taken, and all related documents—from the original LG, its amendments to the final release.

actionCenter.title: Action Center
actionCenter.desc: Think of this as your daily mission control. It’s a single hub listing everything that needs your attention: expiring LGs, pending approvals (for maker-checker workflows), and outstanding bank replies.

step4.title: 4. Taking Action
step4.desc: When it's time to act, the system gives you the tools to get things done quickly and accurately.
step4.point1: **LG Actions:** The system supports a full range of actions other than extension, including amount decrease, liquidation, partial liquidation, amendment, activate none-operative LG, and release.
step4.point2: **LG Actions:** The system supports a full range of actions other than extension, including amount decrease, liquidation, partial liquidation, amendment, activate none-operative LG, and release.

step5.title: 5. Bank Communication & Security
step5.desc: Stay in control of your communication with banks and maintain airtight security.
step5.point1: **Instant Documentation:** It instantly generates the correct instructions and templates for you. All related supporting documents and bank replies are stored securely with the LG record.
step5.point2: **Instant Documentation:** It instantly generates the correct instructions and templates for you. All related supporting documents and bank replies are stored securely with the LG record.

step6.title: 6. Built for Your Business
step6.desc: This system isn’t a rigid tool; it's a flexible platform that you can configure to fit your specific needs.

flexibility.title: Control & Flexibility
flexibility.desc: As an administrator, you define the rules. You can set how actionable LGs are selected, the logic for reminders, renewal preferences, and other behavioral rules.

audit.title: Full Audit Trail
audit.desc: Every action is logged. You’ll have a complete audit trail that shows who did what, when, and what changed across all users and actions. This makes internal reviews and external audits effortless.

cta.title: Ready to Take Control?
cta.desc: LG management can be simple, secure, and smart. See for yourself how a system built by treasurers can transform your operations and empower your growth.
